svg.data-overall-mm: 482.6 x 44.45 x 508 with rack ears (data sheet)
svg.data-power-envelope-note: data sheet "Max power consumption 150W", no configuration or ambient stated
svg.data-psu-redundancy: dual redundant, hot-swappable AC PSUs or -48 VDC PEMs
svg.data-cooling: load-sharing, speed-controlled, hot-swappable fan tray, serviced from the front
svg.data-operating-temp: 0 to 45 C; extended -5 to 55 C for up to 96 hours
svg.data-services: MPLS L2VPN (VPLS, H-VPLS, VPWS), MPLS L3VPN, 802.1Q, 802.1ad Q-in-Q
svg.data-resiliency: sub-50 ms G.8032 R-APS and RSVP-TE FRR, secondary LSP, xSTP, dual-homed VPLS/H-VPLS, LAG, redundant power
svg.data-oam: hardware Y.1564 and RFC 2544 test head, MEF 46 latching loopback, Y.1731 PM, TWAMP
svg.data-local: CLI console and MNG out-of-band Ethernet on RJ45
svg.data-mgmt-protocols: Console, Telnet, SSHv2, RADIUS, TACACS+, SNMP v1/2/3, xFTP, NTP, DHCP client/server, ZTP
